title: the in-whiteboard skill is 51 KB, past the 20,000 characters a compact carries, so every compact costs every node a full reload (about 18k tokens)
body:
Raised from Laksa's dc node on hv's word (Laksa `hv/inbox.dc.md` 2026-10-11 16:36Z: "If it's a change to Intent, then it needs an ussue raised in the Intent project").

**The defect.** `intent/plugins/claude/skills/in-whiteboard/SKILL.md` is 51,366 bytes. Claude Code's compact carries an invoked skill only up to 20,000 characters, so the carried copy stops partway through the header-block section, and `/in-session` loads the whole skill again. Measured in a Laksa node's transcript on 2026-10-11, the full load added 17,959 tokens to the context. That cost recurs on every restart after a compact, for every node, in every project that runs the whiteboard.

**Outcome wanted.** The skill fits under 20,000 characters, so a compact carries it whole and nothing reloads it, and no operational rule is lost. hv's standing word on instruction docs (Laksa `hv/inbox.dc.md` 2026-10-11 16:24Z): "Apart from obvious hard rules, we should probably always err on the side of less is more with skills.md and claude.md etc."

**A draft exists**, untracked in Laksa at `/Users/matts/Devel/prj/Laksa/tmp/dc/md-optimise/in-whiteboard/`: `SKILL.md.proposed` (18,299 bytes, ASCII) and `in-whiteboard.patch` (`diff -u`, which `git apply --check` passes against f9b3419a2). The draft keeps the verbs table, the file layout, the wip.md shape, the hold and say-it-twice rules, and the red flags; it drops the history and the rationale. A probe of 59 rules found none missing. One line is an addition rather than a cut: "re-count live messages right before clearing", taken from Laksa's memory (`wb-clear-sweeps-a-message-that-lands-after-your-read`).
